authors: Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian

lineage: Museum summary based on historical evidence. A specific station interval is not universal and individual khipus are not claimed to have been carried by this particular relay. Full relevant web text was inspected; direct local retrieval failed, so no original-byte cache is claimed.
